nodes.description: Public address state variable initialized with msg.sender, used as the privileged owner in the restricted modifier.
Public uint state variable that records the last completed migration index; written by setCompleted.
Modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the modified function body.
Public function guarded by the restricted modifier that assigns the completed argument to last_completed_migration.
Caller-controlled address used to initialize owner and compared against owner in the restricted modifier.
Non-core uint parameter of setCompleted that is written into last_completed_migration.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable at construction, making the deployer the privileged owner.
The restricted modifier's require compares the untrusted msg.sender against owner, gating execution on caller identity.
The restricted modifier is applied to setCompleted, meaning the caller-identity check governs whether setCompleted can execute.
The completed parameter is an argument consumed by the setCompleted function body.
The completed parameter value is assigned directly into the last_completed_migration state variable.
setCompleted writes the state variable last_completed_migration, mutating contract storage.

normalization_plan.reason: The non-core parameter completed only exists inside setCompleted; fold it into the function node to simplify the graph while preserving the dataflow into last_completed_migration.
